attempts.summary: Configured node1 (chrony) as the cluster's internal time source with a local stratum fallback and LAN-scoped allow rule, and configured node2 to sync exclusively against node1 (10.100.95.10) instead of the public pool. Verified bidirectional sync (node2 selected node1 as source; node1 shows node2 as an NTP client). Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart-evidence protocol on both nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime/chrony health, triggered a native reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed a new boot_id and near-zero uptime proving an actual restart, and re-verified chrony health/config/sync relationship post-restart on each node.
